title: [hotfix] Cap container cpus at 1.8 (2-core VM)
body:
`cpus: '3.0'` from #46 exceeds the 2-core VM, so Docker rejected the container recreate ("range of CPUs is from 0.01 to 2.00"). prod stayed safe on the old container. Capped at 1.8. Validated on the VM: config clean + full-hardening container starts healthy.
